channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Skillet's John Cooper talks legalism, absolute truth and ‘demonic’ label on new Christmas song
item.description: Skillet frontman John Cooper responds to accusations that the band's new Christmas single is "demonic" and shares why he's unapologetic about sharing the Gospel and the truth, no matter the cost. #JohnCooper #Skillet #Christmasmusic

item.title: DOJ wants to defend Christian students punished for opposing girl in boys' locker room
item.description: The United States Department of Justice is taking the side of two Virginia public high school students who were suspended for opposing a transgender bathroom policy on religious grounds. #DOJ #LGBT #transgender #LoudounCounty #schools #gender

item.title: Episcopal priest charged with stealing $300K fights removal from priesthood
item.description: An Episcopal priest who has been accused of stealing around $300,000 from a Texas church is appealing a ruling that removes him from the priesthood. #EpiscopalChurch #EdwardMonk #Texas #theft #crime #appeal

item.title: Pastors accuse PCA of 'demonizing' LGBTQ, sidelining women: 'Spiritually abusive'
item.description: A petition within the Presbyterian Church in America went viral this week after accusing the denomination of being abusive, "white and male-dominant," demonizing toward the LGBTQ community and other grievances. #PresbyterianChurchinAmerica #IrwynInce #DukeKwon #LGBTQ

item.title: Turning Point USA launches chapters at over 500 high schools in Texas, governor says
item.description: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott says hundreds of schools across the state are ready to host chapters of Turning Point USA's high school program, which promotes conservative values for young people. #Texas #TPUSA #CharlieKirk

item.title: White House dismisses pro-lifers' calls to fire FDA commissioner over abortion pill review
item.description: The White House says it has the "utmost confidence" in Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Marty Makary as pro-life leaders call for him to be fired following a report that he delayed a safety review of the abortion drug mifepristone until after the 2026 midterms. #FDA #MaryMakary #abortionpill #mifepristone #prolifemovement

item.title: Kirk Cameron changes stance on doctrine of Hell, says he no longer believes in 'eternal conscious torment'
item.description: Actor and podcaster Kirk Cameron stirred up a theological hornet’s nest after he revealed he no longer believes in a Hell that includes “eternal conscious torment.” #KirkCameron #Hell #Hades

item.title: A look at how world’s 5 Communist countries are cracking down on Christians: report
item.description: Governments in the world’s five remaining communist countries are intensifying control over Christian churches, according to an analysis by a persecution watchdog, which says churches are facing growing legal, financial and operational restrictions under regimes in China, Cuba, Laos, North Korea and Vietnam. #CommunistGovernments #Christians #Churches #ReligiousRestrictions #China #Cuba #Laos #NorthKorea #Vietnam

item.title: Elon Musk affirms belief in Creator, says 'universe came from something'
item.description: Billionaire Elon Musk reiterated his belief in the existence of a Creator during a recent podcast, and claimed God is the figure he most admires. #ElonMusk #KatieMiller #DOGE

item.title: Lutheran group leading Somali outreach in Minnesota warns against sharing the Gospel 'unless a person is dying'
item.description: As the Trump administration prepares to deploy 100 ICE agents to Minnesota, home to an estimated 87,000 people with Somali ties, Lutheran church leaders are pushing back against federal immigration enforcement actions with evangelism. #Somali #Minnesota #PresidentDonaldTrump #Lutheran
